key_catalyst: Nvidia in talks for ~$250B backstop to finance OpenAI data center, reviving circular-financing fears in AI
reasoning: The Nvidia $250B OpenAI backstop is a novel, high-severity catalyst that undermines the AI demand thesis; combined with Chinese chip breakthroughs and surging Fed rate hike odds, it escalates the same AI capex fears that drove QQQ down 1.90% on 7/23. With megacap earnings and the Fed ahead, the pre-market 1.66% drop reflects ongoing absorption rather than an overreaction, and the risk of further de-rating remains acute.
